_about: The ten optional modules a company can switch on (SAR per year each). Names and descriptions are exactly as in the design. Used by the Order page and by the order e-mail.

optional.name: Inventory
optional.desc: Items, levels and value per store, with reorder points.

optional.name: Warehouse counter
optional.desc: Scan to issue or receive, on a screen built for standing up.

optional.name: Fixed assets
optional.desc: Register, depreciation posted for you, and disposals recorded properly.

optional.name: Projects
optional.desc: Budget against actual job by job, with a warning as the budget tightens.

optional.name: Rentals
optional.desc: Hire contracts, usage that drives the bill, and returns with condition.

optional.name: Rooms and front desk
optional.desc: Room types and seasonal rates, a calendar that refuses to double-book, and a guest bill that becomes one invoice.

optional.name: Restaurant till
optional.desc: Menu items selling to their own income accounts, open orders at the table.

optional.name: HR and payroll
optional.desc: Payroll runs posted to the ledger, end of service and leave.

optional.name: CRM
optional.desc: Leads and stages, contact history, and a won deal that becomes a quote and then an invoice.

optional.name: Customer portal
optional.desc: Customers open the invoice from a link, settle it there, and send back documents.
